comments.text: Could you survive in Cuba on just $5 a month while facing frequent blackouts, fuel shortages, and unreliable internet — or would the daily struggle force you to leave? #RealLifeIn

comments.text: What a shame. So much nonsensical AI babble.

comments.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
comments.text: The contrast between trained doctors and teachers struggling financially while tourism-related jobs can pay more is fascinating. Which problem do you think Cuba needs to solve first?

replies.author: @UnseenPlanett
replies.text: I’d start with reliable access to essentials and wages people can live on. Doctors and teachers should be able to build a secure life through their work.

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: I think a lot depends on what people mean by “socialism.” Some are talking about stronger public services and safety nets, while others mean something much broader. The labels often hide very different ideas.
